wall_follow_service Module

bug_as Module

ROS node for controlling the robot navigation.

Subscribes to:

/scan (sensor_msgs/LaserScan): LiDAR data for obstacle detection. /odom (nav_msgs/Odometry): Odometry data for localization.

Publishes to:

/cmd_vel (geometry_msgs/Twist): Velocity commands for the robot.

Clients:

/go_to_point_switch (std_srvs/SetBool): Service to enable or disable the ‘go to point’ behavior. /wall_follower_switch (std_srvs/SetBool): Service to enable or disable the ‘wall following’ behavior.

Action Server:

/reaching_goal (assignment_2_2024/PlanningAction): Action to handle goal reaching tasks.

bug_as.change_state(state)[source]

Changes the robot’s navigation state.

Parameters:

state (int) – The new state to transition to (0: go to point, 1: wall following, 2: done).

bug_as.clbk_laser(msg)[source]

Callback function to process laser scan data and update obstacle regions.

Parameters:

msg (sensor_msgs/LaserScan) – The laser scan message containing distance readings.

bug_as.clbk_odom(msg)[source]

Callback function to update the robot’s position and orientation from odometry data.

Parameters:

msg (nav_msgs/Odometry) – The odometry message containing position and orientation data.

bug_as.done()[source]

Stops the robot by publishing zero velocity commands.

bug_as.main()[source]

Main function to initialize the ROS node and setup subscriptions, publications, and services.

bug_as.normalize_angle(angle)[source]

Normalizes an angle to the range [-pi, pi].

Parameters:

angle (float) – The input angle in radians.

Returns:

The normalized angle.

Return type:

float

bug_as.planning(goal)[source]

Action server callback to handle goal reaching while avoiding obstacles.

Parameters:

goal (assignment_2_2024/PlanningGoal) – The goal position to reach.
